answer: Proof of a paid utility account is a stubborn anchor. Each identity presents one invoice in its own name, verified live against the utility's billing API; the meter number is hashed on the ledger so it cannot be reused, and the account must show twelve months of service. A farm needs a thousand real households with a year of bills, which no script manufactures, and the fable of a virtual crowd dissolves into a garden of actual kitchens. Enrollment costs nothing beyond an existing bill, and each identity owes a voyage of one verified payment per quarter.
